mapper.select: select m.id as matchId, m.season_id as seasonId, se.display_title as seasonTitle, m.division_id as divisionId, d.division_name as divisionName, m.platform_code as platformCode, m.round_no as roundNo, m.match_no as matchNo, m.match_time as matchTime, m.home_event_team_id as homeEventTeamId, ht.team_name_snapshot as homeTeamName, ht.team_logo_file_id as homeTeamLogoFileId, m.away_event_team_id as awayEventTeamId, at.team_name_snapshot as awayTeamName, at.team_logo_file_id as awayTeamLogoFileId, case when ep_home.id is not null then m.home_event_team_id when ep_away.id is not null then m.away_event_team_id else null end as myEventTeamId, case when ep_home.id is not null then m.away_event_team_id when ep_away.id is not null then m.home_event_team_id else null end as opponentEventTeamId, m.match_status as matchStatus, m.publish_status as publishStatus, ls.submission_status as mySubmissionStatus, ls.id as myLatestSubmissionId from basket_match m join basket_season se on se.id = m.season_id and se.is_delete = 0 join basket_division d on d.id = m.division_id and d.is_delete = 0 left join basket_event_team ht on ht.id = m.home_event_team_id and ht.is_delete = 0 left join basket_event_team at on at.id = m.away_event_team_id and at.is_delete = 0 left join basket_event_player ep_home on ep_home.event_team_id = m.home_event_team_id and ep_home.is_delete = 0 and (ep_home.member_id = #{memberId} or ep_home.source_player_id = #{playerId}) left join basket_event_player ep_away on ep_away.event_team_id = m.away_event_team_id and ep_away.is_delete = 0 and (ep_away.member_id = #{memberId} or ep_away.source_player_id = #{playerId}) left join basket_event_team et_cap_home on et_cap_home.id = m.home_event_team_id and et_cap_home.captain_player_id = #{playerId} and et_cap_home.is_delete = 0 left join basket_event_team et_cap_away on et_cap_away.id = m.away_event_team_id and et_cap_away.captain_player_id = #{playerId} and et_cap_away.is_delete = 0 left join ( select s1.match_id, s1.submit_event_team_id, s1.id, s1.submission_status from basket_match_submission s1 join ( select match_id, submit_event_team_id, max(version_no) as max_ver from basket_match_submission where is_delete = 0 group by match_id, submit_event_team_id ) lv on lv.match_id = s1.match_id and lv.submit_event_team_id = s1.submit_event_team_id and lv.max_ver = s1.version_no where s1.is_delete = 0 ) ls on ls.match_id = m.id and ls.submit_event_team_id = case when ep_home.id is not null or et_cap_home.id is not null then m.home_event_team_id when ep_away.id is not null or et_cap_away.id is not null then m.away_event_team_id else null end where m.is_delete = 0 and m.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' and m.match_status != 'CANCELLED' and (ep_home.id is not null or ep_away.id is not null or et_cap_home.id is not null or et_cap_away.id is not null) and m.season_id = #{seasonId} and m.division_id = #{divisionId} and m.match_status = #{matchStatus} and m.publish_status = #{publishStatus} and ls.submission_status = #{submissionStatus} and m.match_time >= now() order by m.match_time desc, m.id desc

select s.id as submissionId, s.match_id as matchId, m.match_no as matchNo, d.division_name as divisionName, s.submit_event_team_id as submitEventTeamId, et.team_name_snapshot as teamName, s.version_no as versionNo, s.submission_status as submissionStatus, s.submit_time as submitTime, s.audit_time as auditTime, s.reject_reason as rejectReason from basket_match_submission s join basket_match m on m.id = s.match_id and m.is_delete = 0 left join basket_division d on d.id = s.division_id and d.is_delete = 0 left join basket_event_team et on et.id = s.submit_event_team_id and et.is_delete = 0 where s.is_delete = 0 and s.submit_member_id = #{memberId} order by s.submit_time desc, s.id desc
